newsitem.title: SYRIA: SYRIA BUYS 13,000 T WHITE SUGAR AT $374.70.
newsitem.headline: SYRIA BUYS 13,000 T WHITE SUGAR AT $374.70.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has bought 13,000 tonnes of white sugar at $374.70 per tonne, a GEZA spokesman said on Thursday.
He told Reuters the sugar, bought from France's Lorico, should be delivered in September.
A tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar was cancelled as price offers did not meet GEZA's conditions.
GEZA also issued a further tender on Wednesday to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment between September 20 and October 20.
